During several recent incident response engagements, FireEye Mandiant investigators uncovered new tools in FIN7's malware arsenal and kept pace as the global criminal operators a ! empted new evasion techniques.

The full evasion achieved against the detection engines deployed to VirusTotal - as compared to an unsigned BOOSTWRITE sample with an invalid checksum- illustrates that FIN7's methods were e ' ective in subve # ing both traditional detection and ML binary classi " cation engines.
In this blog, we reveal two of FIN7's new tools that we have called BOOSTWRITE and RDFSNIFFER.
